'''Revelation Warlord Of Tatooine''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Revelation]]
* '''Published:''' 5 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal!|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' No Money, No Parts, No Deal!
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 NMNPND Revelation DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

No, not Jabba. Jabba's a CRIME lord, get the difference? No, this Warlord sends out troops to do his dirty work, while he sits quietly enjoying his junk. Junk? That's right...WATTO!

The published list has 68 cards.

== Strategy ==

Yes, a lot of characters. This is WATTO, man! Characters fly out like a swarm of angry insects. They drain. They battle. They win. Do I have to explain the characters? They?re beat squads. IG-88 and Bossk are beasts with the Colo Claw Fish. First turn flip with Reegesk and Watto and evade with barrier/telepathy. Then go out and get im?! Twi?lek for Expand, Expand the Junkyard and deploy Watto for free from reserve AGAIN! Twice more if you get out Cantina/Audience Chamber (you should). This deck is a lot difference from my other decks. It has lightsabers- but no YAB/Sniper combos. I did that on purpose. Gave me eight more deck slots ; )

With my beat squads, why should I have to resort to Sniper/Dark Strike? Okay, so destiny?s bad- but you?ve got a Claw Fish! Watto is self-explanatory- and don?t ask me to do that YCHF/S & D thing, I decided it wasn?t worth the two card slots. If you can't go get him, drain him out, AAA him out, Watto him out. Ahh, the mighty Watto deck.

Please excuse the question marks- they're supposed to be apostrophes, and my computer turns them into question marks.

Please give me some suggestions.
